analyst_view.overall: Early view: Levante play their second home game in five days after the Elche relegation clash, this time against a Racing side that is open at both ends: Racing concede the most in the league but have Yassir Zabiri, who has nine league goals. Racing's away form had been poor until the 2-1 win at Málaga, and Andrés Martín may be back from his hamstring injury by then.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.8 goals, with 2.5 for Levante. Racing do give a lot away, but Levante's attack is limited (six shots at Celta) and Castro's side plays cautiously. Over 2.5 is plausible, but nearly four overrates Levante.

corners.text: The site expects 10.9 corners. Racing average about five corners a game, and Levante rarely pin teams back; they took one corner at Balaídos. I'd expect nine or ten.

cards.text: The model has 4.7 cards and I see no strong reason to move it. Levante took two yellows at Celta and Racing two at Málaga, so it may come down to whether this turns into another relegation scrap and who referees.

shots.text: The site expects 33.7 shots, which is very high. Racing average about 12 shots a game and Levante's output has been modest, so the high 20s is more realistic even in an open game.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.9 on target. Racing put about 4.5 a game on target and Levante rarely get to double figures in shots, so I see about nine in total.
